quran_foundation_coverage_correction.correction: The earlier registry treatment understated the documented Content API surface. Official v4 documentation explicitly covers Quran text, verses, translations, tafsir, audio, recitations, chapter reciters, pages, juz, hizb, ruku, manzil and related resources, and chapter-reciter records expose qirat metadata.
quran_foundation_coverage_correction.remaining_verification_boundary: The documentation establishes the API contract and qirat metadata field, but does not by itself prove that every one of the Ten Canonical Readings is available as a complete production dataset. That requires enumerating the production resource records after authorized access.
quran_foundation_coverage_correction.governance: API access remains separate from redistribution rights and scholarly provenance.

quran_foundation_primary_service_contrac.purpose: Primary official service contract for Quran Core. This layer records the programmable source surface; it does not write directly to Corpus.
quran_foundation_primary_service_contrac.source_of_truth: Quran Foundation official Content API v4 documentation
quran_foundation_primary_service_contrac.provenance_rule: Arabic canonical text remains a separate content class. Translations, tafsir, tajweed representations, recitations and qiraat metadata are never silently merged into canonical text.
quran_foundation_primary_service_contrac.acquisition_rule: Rechercher may acquire or synchronize only after endpoint access, resource identity, provenance and rights are verified.
quran_foundation_primary_service_contrac.rights_rule: API access does not itself grant redistribution rights; apply resource/source-specific terms before public storage or publication.
quran_foundation_primary_service_contrac.sync_rule: Use official Content Sync/resource snapshots where available instead of repeatedly rebuilding a local copy from ad-hoc requests.
quran_foundation_primary_service_contrac.ai_rule: AI may assist indexing, matching and discovery only; it cannot generate or replace Quran text, translations, tafsir or qiraat as authoritative source content.

translation_expansion_contract.goal: Expand Quran translation acquisition beyond the current Quran Foundation inventory using primary institutional and verified QuranEnc editions; never use AI as a translation source.

services.scope: translation edition catalog and Quran meaning translations
services.coverage_rule: Catalog enumeration is authoritative for actual available editions; language directories alone are not proof of a translation.
services.integrity_rule: Preserve translation text, footnotes, translation key, version and last_update; no automatic retranslation.
services.rights_rule: Follow QuranEnc terms/policies and retain required publisher/source/version attribution per edition.
services.ai_rule: AI is discovery/matching only and cannot author, replace or retranslate an authoritative Quran translation.
services.language_scope_note: QuranEnc currently advertises 80+ languages; the registry must enumerate actual editions and not convert that headline into an 80+ complete-translation claim.

institutional_translation_priority.rule: Prefer translations issued or formally supervised by ministries, national Quran complexes, official Islamic affairs bodies, universities and recognized scholarly institutions when a primary source can verify the edition.
